name: clipsubtitles
title: ClipSubtitles
summary: Agent-native captioning studio: import a short video, generate word-timed captions, review and edit through a versioned project, preview for free, approve an immutable credit quote, and render MP4 / transparent overlay / SRT / VTT.

endpoints.sessionMode: stateless (one transport per request, no server-side session state)

clientRegistration.local: Dynamic Client Registration on the mock authorization server (AUTH_MODE=mock)
clientRegistration.production: DCR or CIMD through WorkOS AuthKit — dashboard setting, see docs/directory/cimd-dcr-notes.md [gate 3]

verification.production: RS256 pinned to the WorkOS JWKS; issuer and audience from config
verification.local: HS256 with a local dev secret

scopes.captions:write: Create/update projects, start generation, previews, paid renders, cancel tasks

auth.scopeEnforcement: fail-closed per tool and per REST route
auth.revocation: per-client grants (oauth_grants); revoking a grant makes the client's next call 401

tools.name: create_caption_project
tools.title: Create caption project
tools.sideEffects: Creates a project; with sourceUrl, fetches a public http(s) video (SSRF-guarded, DNS-pinned, size-bounded). Without sourceUrl, returns a short-lived web upload link for the user.
tools.description: Create a caption project from a short video. Provide a public http(s) sourceUrl to import it directly, or omit it to receive a web upload link the user must open to upload the file. Returns the project and, when importing, a durable task id to poll with get_caption_task.

tools.name: generate_captions
tools.title: Generate captions
tools.sideEffects: Starts a durable transcription + segmentation task; bumps the project version when it commits. Spoken words are never rewritten; vocabulary only biases recognition.
tools.description: Start transcription, normalization, semantic/prosody segmentation, and initial styling for a project whose source is ready. Returns a durable task.

tools.name: get_caption_project
tools.title: Get caption project
tools.description: Read the current project: version, source, transcript summary, caption pages (text + timing), style, QA, active tasks, and recent exports. Request words=true with a bounded window to inspect word-level timing.

tools.name: update_caption_project
tools.title: Update caption project
tools.sideEffects: Applies a transactional batch of constrained edits with an optimistic version check (VERSION_CONFLICT on mismatch). Every edit increments the version and invalidates open render quotes.
tools.description: Apply constrained edits (word text/timing, page split/merge, resegmentation, style, position, title) with an optimistic version check.

tools.name: render_caption_preview
tools.title: Render caption preview
tools.sideEffects: Starts a durable low-resolution preview render (rate limited). The finished task carries a short-lived download URL.
tools.description: Render a fast, low-resolution preview clip (default: up to 8 seconds from the start) of the current project version.

tools.name: render_caption_export
tools.title: Render caption export (paid)
tools.sideEffects: Step 1 (no approval field): returns an immutable quote and status quote_required — nothing is reserved. Step 2 (approval {quoteId, approvedCreditCost}): reserves credits and starts the render. Credits are charged exactly once on success and released on failure/cancel. A quote is bound to the project version, content hash, settings, and price version, and expires.
tools.idempotency: optional idempotencyKey — duplicate approvals return the same task
tools.description: Two-step paid render: quote, then approve.

tools.name: get_caption_task
tools.title: Get caption task
tools.description: Poll a durable task. Finished render tasks include export metadata with short-lived download URLs. Errors are bounded and carry an errorRef for support.

tools.name: cancel_caption_task
tools.title: Cancel caption task
tools.sideEffects: Requests cooperative cancellation; reserved credits for a cancelled render are released. Finished tasks cannot be cancelled.
tools.description: Request cancellation of a queued or running task.

billing.onboarding: beta credit grant on first sign-in (INITIAL_CREDIT_GRANT); purchases are a parked decision (PARKED_ACTIONS gate 8)
billing.quote: immutable; bound to project version + content hash + output settings + price version; TTL enforced
billing.reserve: on approval, in the same transaction that creates the task
billing.settle: exactly once, when the render succeeds (atomic with task completion)
billing.release: on failure, cancellation, or lease expiry
billing.idempotency: ledger entries are keyed; repeated reserve/settle/release calls are no-ops

limits.note: Exact numbers live in LIMITS (packages/contracts/src/limits.ts) and are enforced server-side; the values below are descriptions, not copies.
limits.uploads: bounded size, claimed atomically before streaming
limits.sourceUrlImport: public http(s) only; private/loopback/link-local addresses rejected after DNS resolution; size-bounded
limits.rateLimits: per-principal token buckets on authenticated routes; anonymous limits keyed by client address

dataHandling.inputs: video/audio files, public video URLs, optional vocabulary hints, optional language tag
dataHandling.derived: transcripts, caption pages, style, rendered previews/exports
dataHandling.storage: workspace-scoped object store + SQLite/Postgres-shaped repositories; every read is scoped by workspace
dataHandling.retention: configurable sweeps for uploads, previews, exports, and purged workspaces (services/retention.ts); documented on the privacy page [after deploy]
dataHandling.logging: structured logs and audit events redact content and credential keys; transcript text is never logged
dataHandling.untrustedContent: transcripts, captions, titles and filenames are data, returned under an explicit content notice (CONTENT_NOTICE); never interpreted as instructions
dataHandling.thirdParties: transcription providers are config-gated adapters; none are enabled by default and no live provider has been benchmarked or contacted from this repository

safety.paidActions: only render_caption_export after an explicit approval of the exact quote
safety.destructiveActions: none exposed via MCP (no delete tools); cancellation only releases reservations
safety.externalActions: none — the server never posts to third-party platforms
safety.promptInjection: media/transcript content is quarantined as data; tool descriptions instruct the model accordingly

evidence.conformance: pnpm mcp:conformance — initialize, tools/list (8 tools), DCR + PKCE, full workflow to a completed render over Streamable HTTP
evidence.apiTests: packages/server/src/test/*.test.ts — auth, scopes, idempotency, quotes, billing, uploads, retention, SSRF guard
